about_the_game:
The gods' temples lie shattered. Will you be the one to uncover the truth?

Oblation invites you to a pixelated fantasy world, directly inspired by Seth Withrow's compelling book. Journey through the distant, scarred land of Exulceratio on a pilgrimage fueled by a desire for justice.

Fight your way through hordes of foes, mastering diverse weapons and utilizing potent magic potions. Strengthen your character through engaging side quests, ensuring you're ready for the most challenging battles. You won't be alone; many friends will join your side, offering their aid in your quest.

Test your mettle against cunning puzzles, relentless enemies, and intricate challenges. Only by overcoming these obstacles can you bring clarity and justice to a world shrouded in ruin.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or newer
  • Processor: Any processor from the last 15 years
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any graphics card with 128 MB or integrated graphics
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card (or integrated audio)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 recommended for best compatibility
  • Processor: Any processor from the last 15 years
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any graphics card with 128 MB or integrated graphics
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card (or integrated audio)

short_description: Oblation is a top-down, pixelated open-world RPG where you explore a vast land, level up your stats, and recruit support characters to uncover a deep truth.
